_: The shape of the secrets file the run keeps outside any repository and deletes, on the person's word, once every value is in the parameter store. A value is what the run generated or derived, what the person gave, or the word later; a provider the person did not choose has no line. The bucket on AWS needs no line: the task's own role reads and writes it.
DATABASE_CA: derived: the regional certificate bundle of the database service, as PEM
TUNNEL_TOKEN: derived: the connector token of the tunnel
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET: asked: the client secret of the GitHub App (or of an OAuth app), or later
GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: asked, with an organization: the private key of the GitHub App, as PEM, its lines joined with \n; or later
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: asked: the client secret of the OAuth client, or later
S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: only with the bucket on R2 (sizing.md, Options): asked, the key made in the Cloudflare dashboard
S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: only with the bucket on R2: its secret
